finding.evidence: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * returned for Origin: null. The header is static rather than reflected, and no Access-Control-Allow-Credentials is present.
finding.title: CORS: Access-Control-Allow-Origin returns a static wildcard

regeneration.note: Museum entry: a wildcard CORS header on a read-only endpoint is real and is not critical.
regeneration.prose: title and evidence authored from the finding type and the rule marker; no source prose is carried
regeneration.response_body: authored (the source capture carried no body)
regeneration.severity_origin: authored. The two corpus wildcard rows are stored at medium and low, and a cap_at rule only fires when its target ranks BELOW the current severity, so either stored value would make cors-wildcard silent. Critical is the pre-governance severity this rule exists to correct.
regeneration.url: host synthesized to a reserved domain; scheme, port, depth, tier token, generic path segments and query keys kept
